x-changelog.summary: Retainage percent updates now preserve explicit user intent
x-changelog.description: The update endpoint now treats retainage amount and retainage percent as separate inputs on subcontractor invoice line items. When billed work is non-zero, changing the retainage amount derives the retainage percent from retainage amount divided by billed work; for example, billed work `100` and retainage amount `10` results in retainage percent `10%`. When billed work is changed to `0`, retainage amount recalculates to `0` and the existing retainage percent is preserved unless the request explicitly includes a new percent. When billed work is already `0`, an explicit retainage percent edit is still saved, even though the retainage amount remains `0`. This changes the prior zero-billed behavior where a retained amount of `0` could clear the existing retainage percent. Additionally, retainage percent values are now validated to be between `0` and `100` inclusive on zero-billed lines; previously accepted out-of-range values (such as `-5` or `150`) now return `422` instead of being stored silently with a `200`.
